verdict.rationale: Unleash documents background automation for releases. Release management "automates" rollouts, impact metrics can automatically advance milestones or pause rollouts and disable environments when thresholds are crossed, and releases can be scheduled for a specific date and time. These automations are limited to feature-flag rollout workflows rather than general-purpose user-defined automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow builder beyond rollouts, detail on how scheduled and metric-triggered automations are configured and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
